verdict.rationale: Supabase's branching feature lets users create separate environments to test schema/config/feature changes without affecting production, which is a git-like versioning mechanism, but this applies to database schema/config rather than 'automations' specifically, and there is no explicit rollback or review (PR-style) workflow documented for Edge Functions, triggers, or other automation-like constructs. Missing for 10: explicit automation objects (workflows/triggers/functions) with versioning, diff/review, and one-click rollback; independent/hands-on confirmation of rollback working.
